commands.name: node.create
commands.description: Create a layer (frame, rect, ellipse, line, text or instance) at a position inside a parent frame or on the canvas.

parent.description: Parent frame id; null or omitted for the canvas

props.description: Any other layer properties (fill, text, name, ...)

id.description: Optional id for the new layer

commands.name: node.set
commands.description: Set properties on layers: geometry (x, y, w, h, rotation), fill, stroke, strokeWidth, radius, opacity, text and font properties, name, clip.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.move
commands.description: Move layers by (dx, dy) in canvas units, optionally into another frame (parent) or onto the canvas (parent null). In an auto-layout frame the move reorders.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.nudge
commands.description: Nudge selection

commands.name: node.reparent
commands.description: Put layers into a frame (or the canvas) at a child index, keeping their position on screen.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.rename
commands.description: Rename layer

commands.name: edit.delete
commands.description: Delete layers and everything inside them.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: edit.duplicate
commands.description: Duplicate

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.insertTree
commands.description: Insert copied layer trees ({rootIds, nodes}) into a frame or the canvas, offset by (dx, dy).

commands.name: node.setVisible
commands.description: Show or hide layers

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.setLocked
commands.description: Lock or unlock layers

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.order
commands.description: Arrange layers

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: arrange.front
commands.description: Bring to front

commands.name: arrange.back
commands.description: Send to back

commands.name: arrange.forward
commands.description: Bring forward

commands.name: arrange.backward
commands.description: Send backward

commands.name: node.frameSelection
commands.description: Wrap the selected layers in a new frame.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.ungroup
commands.description: Remove frame (keep contents)

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: layout.add
commands.description: Give a frame auto layout, or wrap the selected layers in a new auto-layout frame.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: layout.remove
commands.description: Remove auto layout

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: layout.set
commands.description: Change auto layout settings: mode (row, column, none), wrap, gap, pad [top, right, bottom, left], align (start, center, end, stretch), justify (start, center, end, between).

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.setSizing
commands.description: Set resizing (hug, fill, fixed)

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.setConstraints
commands.description: Set constraints

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: text.set
commands.description: Set text

commands.name: text.styleRange
commands.description: Style characters [start, end) of a text layer: fontWeight, fontSize, italic, fill (#hex), decoration (underline, strike); null removes a key.

commands.name: doc.rename
commands.description: Rename document

commands.name: component.create
commands.description: Turn the selected frame into a main component (wrapping other layers in a frame first).

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: component.instance
commands.description: Place an instance of a main component (the selected one by default) beside it, or at (x, y) in a parent.

commands.name: component.detach
commands.description: Detach instance

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: component.combineVariants
commands.description: Put the selected main components into one component set; names like "Size=Large, State=Hover" become variant properties.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: instance.setVariant
commands.description: Set variant property

commands.name: instance.swap
commands.description: Swap instance

commands.name: instance.reset
commands.description: Reset all overrides

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: style.create
commands.description: Create a shared style: {type:"color", name, value:"#RRGGBB"} or {type:"text", name, fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, lineHeight}.

commands.name: style.fromSelection
commands.description: Make a shared style from the first selected layer's fill, stroke or text properties and apply it to the selection.

commands.name: style.update
commands.description: Edit style

commands.name: style.delete
commands.description: Delete a shared style; layers that used it keep its current values.

commands.name: node.applyStyle
commands.description: Apply a shared style to layers (kind fill, stroke or text), or detach it with styleId null (the layer keeps the values).

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: asset.add
commands.description: Store an image (base64 data, MIME type) in the document and return its asset id.

commands.name: image.place
commands.description: Place a stored image asset as a rectangle with an image fill at (x, y), at its natural size unless w and h are given.

commands.name: vector.create
commands.description: Create a vector layer from SVG path data given in the parent frame's coordinates (or canvas coordinates with no parent).

commands.name: vector.setPath
commands.description: Replace a vector layer's path; d is in the layer's own units (0..w, 0..h before the edit). The layer box refits to the new path.

commands.name: node.flatten
commands.description: Turn shapes into editable vector paths (rotation is baked into the path).

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: boolean.apply
commands.description: Combine shapes into one vector: union, subtract (from the bottom-most), intersect or exclude.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: boolean.union
commands.description: Boolean: Union

commands.name: boolean.subtract
commands.description: Boolean: Subtract

commands.name: boolean.intersect
commands.description: Boolean: Intersect

commands.name: boolean.exclude
commands.description: Boolean: Exclude

commands.name: variable.createCollection
commands.description: New variable collection

commands.name: variable.addMode
commands.description: Add a mode (for example Dark) to a collection; every variable copies its first mode's value.

commands.name: variable.renameMode
commands.description: Rename variable mode

commands.name: variable.create
commands.description: Create a variable (type color, number, string or boolean) in a collection with a value for its first mode.

commands.name: variable.set
commands.description: Set a variable's value in one mode; value may be {alias: variableId}.

commands.name: variable.rename
commands.description: Rename variable

commands.name: variable.delete
commands.description: Delete a variable; layers bound to it keep their current values.

commands.name: node.bindVariable
commands.description: Bind a layer property (fill, stroke, w, h, opacity, radius, strokeWidth, fontSize, gap, padding, text, name, visible) to a variable, or unbind with variable null.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: node.setMode
commands.description: Choose which mode of a collection a frame or instance (and everything inside it) uses; mode null inherits.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: proto.set
commands.description: Set what happens in present mode when a layer is clicked or hovered: navigate to a frame, open an overlay, go back, or open a URL. proto null removes it.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: proto.setStart
commands.description: Set as prototype start

commands.name: page.add
commands.description: New page

commands.name: page.open
commands.description: Go to page

commands.name: page.rename
commands.description: Rename page

commands.name: page.delete
commands.description: Delete page

commands.name: node.moveToPage
commands.description: Move to page

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: layout.setGrids
commands.description: Set a frame's layout grids: [{type: columns|rows|grid, count, gutter, margin, size, color}]. Grids show on the canvas only.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

commands.name: import.svg
commands.description: Import SVG markup as a frame of editable layers at (x, y): rectangles and ellipses stay shapes, other elements become vectors, groups become frames.

commands.name: import.figma
commands.description: Import Figma REST API JSON (a file with ?geometry=paths, or a nodes response) as new pages. Best effort: image fills become grey, instances arrive detached.

commands.name: export.code
commands.description: Return code for layers (default: selection, else the page): format html (a full HTML page with CSS), react (a JSX component) or css (declarations for the first layer).

commands.name: component.addProp
commands.description: Add a property to a main component: type text (drives a text layer), boolean (shows or hides a layer) or swap (chooses the main of a nested instance). target is the layer inside the main.

commands.name: component.removeProp
commands.description: Remove component property

commands.name: instance.setProp
commands.description: Set a component property on an instance (text, true/false, or a main component id for swap); value null resets it to the default.

commands.name: export.avd
commands.description: Export the given layers (default: selection, else everything) as an Android Vector Drawable XML string; download saves a file. Text and images are skipped.

commands.name: node.setMinMax
commands.description: Set minimum and maximum width and height (null clears one); auto layout and resizing respect them.

ids.description: Node ids; defaults to the current selection

_note: Document commands only; view, selection and file commands register at run time from the same registry.
